name: PortInput
description:
A TCP or UDP port: whole numbers 1–65535, no grouping ("8080", never "8,080"), and the
service usually on it named beside the number. Arrow keys step; there are no steppers by
default, because nobody clicks from 443 to 8443.
signature: ({ service, services, steppers, width, className, value, defaultValue, ...rest }: PortInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the text input loses focus, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the parsed number, or null when the box is empty, as it is typed, stepped or
scrubbed. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: service
props.description: Name the usual service inside the box ("443 HTTPS"). Default true.

props.name: services
props.description: Your own names for ports, checked before the well-known list ({ 8443: "UniFi controller" }).

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: steppers
props.description: Show the − / + steppers (default). Arrow keys always step.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).
